description: EEDI-static task_3_4 golden common-test set. 676 selected students, four ability bands with 169 students each, all selected students answered the same 296 test questions. Generated from requested top-256 popular-question coverage tier.

selection_method.ability_banding: quartiles of task_3_4 empirical accuracy among students with at least 50 answered questions
selection_method.seed_question_rule: top questions by number of answering students, descending; ties by larger QuestionId first from deterministic tuple sort
selection_method.cover_user_rule: students who answered every seed question
selection_method.balanced_student_rule: within cover users, take top 169 students per ability level by answered_question_count_task_3_4 descending, then UserId descending
selection_method.final_test_question_rule: all questions answered by every selected student
